text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend my days being as good a trainer as
I can be for Maruzensky,
and before long,
the time comes for her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Have you come all this way to
see me off? Hehe, how
kind of you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Have you come all this way to
see me off? Hehe, how
kind of you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just bombdiggity. ♪ The weather today
is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know, the wind I feel when I run is
really special. So I'm going to
take it all in
and have a great race.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: See you when it's over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her smile unwavering, she fully utilizes her
talents in the race.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're at the last turn and Maruzensky's
still in the lead! She hasn't
given up an
inch since the start!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I can go faster than this!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's speeding up! She's left the
pack in the dust! She
outclasses the
competition, and she knows it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky still has a huge lead, and...
she clears the finish line! Her
debut race
ends in an overwhelming victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A moment later, the awestruck murmurs of
the crowd rise to a roar.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer. ♪ Shall we get going—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer. ♪ Shall we get going—

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
This is it... Your day is finally here! The day
of your debut!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right! I know I'm going to win! This is the
first step on the road to
becoming a Triple
Crown Champion!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! I know you can do it! Put
all that training to good use
and win!

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's all for today once we get back
to the academy, right? Do
you have any
plans after?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's all for today once we get back
to the academy, right? Do
you have any
plans after?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you're not too busy... How about a
drive?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. You're okay, right? Great, I'll come
pick you up! Wait for me at
the school
entrance, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As per Maruzensky's instructions, I wait for
her at the entrance when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrrrooom! Screeeech...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky gets out of her sporty, cherry
red car and walks over to
me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's that look on your face for?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I knooow! Isn't she the best?! This little
beauty's my partner, Tata!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A sleek, cool body with an engine that
roars like a tiger... And check
out the
scissor doors. Aren't they fabulous?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Nothing feels better than riding in this
baby! You're gonna love it, so
hurry! Get
in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a seat in Maruzensky's beloved
"partner".

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The acceleration! The flowing scenery!
Isn't this the best?! But you
still haven't
seen how bad to the bone Tata really is!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry—I follow the rules of the road!
Except... I take them to
the limit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a terrifying time that seems to last
forever.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, that was great! And ending a
freewheeling drive at the beach...
How
romantic!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How was it? I bet riding in Tata was like a
taste of heaven!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How was it? I bet riding in Tata was like a
taste of heaven!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good, I'm so glad you enjoyed it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Driving's wonderful. You let your body be
taken by the speed and
become one with
the wind. It's like you can keep going
forever.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Being able to experience that joy with my
own body... I'm so happy I
was born an
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And the thrill of speeding faster than the
wind... There's nothing like
it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know it! But that's really all there is to
it for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Most racers have some dream to fulfill or
goal to boast about. But
such complicated
matters... they're not for girls like me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong. I love running and
racing, you know? It's just...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Today when I was next to so many big
dreamers, I caught myself
wondering if
I'm... in the right place.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Am I being a downer?! That won't
do for our first drive
together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Am I being a downer?! That won't
do for our first drive
together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! Since we're at the beach, how
about a little game of tag?
You know, like
those scenes they have in the trendy TV
soaps!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you're "it"! Ahaha, catch me if you
caaan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just a girl without lofty dreams or goals...
It feels as though I got to
peek under the
hood and take a look at who she truly is
behind that
precocious smile.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, hahaha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you never know till you try!
Keep at it, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you never know till you try!
Keep at it, Trainer! ♪
